episodes.title: Efectuar lo acordado
episodes.summary: The professor recruits Tokio and 7 other criminals for a grand heist, targeting the Royal Mint of Spain.

episodes.title: Imprudencias letales
episodes.summary: Hostage negotiator Raquel makes initial contact with the Professor. One of the hostages is a crucial part of the thieves' plans.

episodes.title: Errar al disparar
episodes.summary: A new step of the robbers will lead the police to act more quickly. Inspector Murillo will not hesitate to give the green light against the Dalís who will go outside of the FNMT. How many lives will the biggest heist in history take?

episodes.title: Caballo de Troya
episodes.summary: Sub-Inspector Ángel will be one of the policemen who will set foot inside the National Currency and Stamp Factory, but also, Suarez, the head of the GEOs, will try to camouflage himself among the other hostages. Will they succeed?

episodes.title: El día de la marmota
episodes.summary: The biggest robbery in history also has loose ends and The Professor never thought he was in such a difficult situation. Raquel will travel to the origin of the plan and find an important clue. Will they discover The Professor?

episodes.title: La cálida Guerra Fría
episodes.summary: The problems inside and outside the National Currency and Stamp Factory are growing. The biggest robbery in history does not allow any mistakes and each time, the tension and fear is rising. What opportunities are there for everything to go well?

episodes.title: Refrigerada inestabilidad
episodes.summary: A new police plan will make Raquel enter the National Factory of Currency and Stamp, right at the core of the biggest heist in history. Berlin, will be responsible for being the most extravagant host that the inspector has ever seen. What is their plan?

episodes.title: Tú lo has buscado
episodes.summary: Inside the National Factory of Currency and Stamp a rebellion between hostages and robbers is unleashed; an explosion lets some hostages escape and an immense shootout between the police and the robbers is happening. Will it be the end of the biggest heist in history?

episodes.title: El que la sigue la consigue
episodes.summary: The Professor discovers that Rachel's mother knows that he is the mastermind of the robbery and the police finally enters the factory. Will they capture the robbers?

episodes.title: Se acabaron las máscaras
episodes.summary: The police finds the house where The Professor has planned everything. Tokyo and Berlin are fighting about how to proceed.

episodes.title: La cabeza del plan
episodes.summary: Tokyo is questioned by the police. The Professor and Raquel's ex-husband are getting into a fight.

episodes.title: Cuestión de eficacia
episodes.summary: The hostages are trying to execute an outbreak, while things are escalating between the robbers. Will The Professor make his call in time?

episodes.title: ¿Qué hemos hecho?
episodes.summary: Raquel is discovering the identity of The Professor. The tension inside the House of national Stamp and Currency is rising.

episodes.title: A contrarreloj
episodes.summary: The execution of the plan is in its final stages.Inspector Raquel is accused of working together with The Professor.

episodes.title: Bella ciao
episodes.summary: The police are storming into the National House of Stamp and Currency. Will the hostages be saved and can the robbers escape?

episodes.title: Hemos vuelto
episodes.summary: When Río is captured, a distraught Tokyo turns to the Professor for help. Armed with a bold new plan, they reunite the team in order to rescue him.

episodes.title: Aikido
episodes.summary: The Professor recruits Martín to put his brother's plan into action and target the Bank of Spain. First step? Create total chaos.

episodes.title: 48 metros bajo el suelo
episodes.summary: Tokyo and Nairobi's efforts go drastically awry. The Professor recalls Berlín detailing how they'd steal the gold from the water-logged vault.

episodes.title: La hora del delfín
episodes.summary: Tamayo's breaches of protocol surprise the Professor. Bogotá calms Denver's anxieties. With time running out, Palermo initiates the "Flipper" plan.

episodes.title: Bum, bum, ciao
episodes.summary: The Professor shocks officials with his latest stunt, but in response, a new inspector rattles Raquel. Palermo and Nairobi get into a heated argument.

episodes.title: Todo pareció insignificante
episodes.summary: Just as Inspector Sierra orchestrates a plan to sneak a team into the Bank of Spain, the Professor and Raquel lose communication with Palermo.

episodes.title: Pequeñas vacaciones
episodes.summary: Tokyo's happiness turns bittersweet. Ángel closes in on a quarreling Raquel and the Professor. Authorities offer a multimillion-dollar reward for tips.

episodes.title: La deriva
episodes.summary: Tokyo attempts to drown her sorrows. Sierra uses personal tactics to target a vulnerable Nairobi, while Suárez continues to hunt down Raquel.

episodes.title: Game Over
episodes.summary: Anger and grief heighten tensions between the group. The Professor, while in mourning, attempts to make a daring and dangerous escape.

episodes.title: La boda de Berlín
episodes.summary: Palermo shocks the group with his actions. Sierra pressures her subject to take a deal. The Professor remembers his brother's wedding.

episodes.title: Lección de anatomía
episodes.summary: The Professor's mole attempts to pass along his message to the person inside the tent. Denver's jealousy toward Mónica and Rio's friendship heightens.

episodes.title: Suspiros de España
episodes.summary: In the past, Berlin predicts that Gandía will cause problems for the operation. Sierra's interrogation of Lisboa leads to a personal revelation.

episodes.title: 5 minutos antes
episodes.summary: Denver turns to an undercover source for help. Nairobi attempts to motivate her team as the danger around them intensifies.

episodes.title: KO técnico
episodes.summary: With Nairobi held hostage, Gandía negotiates with the crew. The Professor desperately seeks a new plan to save his team.

episodes.title: Tumbar la carpa
episodes.summary: The group reels following the attack on one of their own. The Professor puts his adjusted plan in motion with the help of new recruits and Palermo.

episodes.title: Plan París
episodes.summary: The Professor, Benjamin and the others attempt to free Lisboa. Tokyo's anger threatens her faith in the plan. Sierra takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: El final del camino
episodes.summary: The Professor faces off with Sierra as Tamayo raises the stakes of the negotiations by calling the army. In the past, Berlin meets with a family member.

episodes.title: ¿Crees en la reencarnación?
episodes.summary: Arturo seizes an opportunity to fight back while escalating a personal vengeance. Lisbon makes a crucial discovery.

episodes.title: El espectáculo de la vida
episodes.summary: A betrayal and an emergency both catch Sierra by surprise. Palermo rallies the troops as the army closes in on the gang.

episodes.title: Tu sitio en el cielo
episodes.summary: With Helsinki's life in danger, the thieves mount a covert counter attack. Years earlier, Berlin and his son conduct their first heist together.

episodes.title: Vivir muchas vidas
episodes.summary: While surrounded by gunfire and trapped in the kitchen, Tokyo reminisces about her first love and her initial encounter with the Professor.

episodes.title: Válvulas de escape
episodes.summary: Sierra takes advantage of the Professor's grief and gains the upper hand. Meanwhile, the team deals with the emotional fallout of their dead friend.

episodes.title: Ciencia ilusionada
episodes.summary: Tamayo mounts a manhunt in his neighborhood as his foes hide. In the past, Berlin and Palermo explain how they plan on getting the gold out of the bank.

episodes.title: La teoría de la elegancia
episodes.summary: Tamayo hunts for the gold as the team races against the clock. Mónica worries she's having a psychotic break. Years earlier, Berlin is deceived.

episodes.title: Lo que se habla en la cama
episodes.summary: The Professor is left reeling after his tactics are used against him, and when it seems like all hope is lost, he makes a bold decision.

episodes.title: Una tradición familiar
episodes.summary: With multiple lives on the line and Spain's economy at stake, the Professor and Tamayo engage in one final showdown.
